result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales-rep list uses.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10020). I changed its `ORDER BY` to the sales-rep version and updated its Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

I ran `RegionManagerTest` (5 tests), `SupportTicketTest` (5) and `DemoScenarioTest` (1) offline, and all passed. I didn't add a test for the new ordering. Nothing was committed.
